name: Wayfarer Tongue L1: The Tongue That Does Not Lie

system.source: Bad Eden Bulwark + Shadow Courier v1.0 (RFI-native rules)

description.value:
Every message is already halfway arrived.

Mode: Herald / drift: Away.

Your default Package type is Message. You may carry one Message at a time — a specific piece of information given to you by an NPC, ally, or faction, intended for a specific recipient. The Message is recorded narratively (write it on your sheet's Package field).

While carrying a Message:

  • You reroll the lowest die on Insight (Soul) checks made about or against the Message's intended recipient.

  • You reroll the lowest die on Diplomacy (Presence) checks made to secure safe passage, hospitality, or audience related to delivering the Message.

On delivery: When you successfully deliver a Message to its intended recipient (the GM confirms it counts), your Pace pool refills to maximum, and the faction that entrusted the Message gains +1 Intrigue OP.

You may receive a new Message any time your Package slot is empty.

system.requirements: Route of the Wayfarer Tongue, Shadow Courier Initiation 1
